blocks.text: Fig 15.14 lens ki ubhri (convex) satah ko hamwar sheeshe ki plate se chhoota dikhati hai. Dono satahon ke darmiyan hawa ki patli tah banti hai. Aik rang ki roshni mein dekhne par yeh intizam gol interference fringes dikhata hai (Fig 15.15, kitab mein tasveer). Newton ne inhein parha aur yeh Newton's rings kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: hawa mein ray t motai aur n index ki patli tah se takrati; aik ray oopar ki satah se mun'akis aur doosri tah mein ja kar neeche se mun'akis; dono aankh ki taraf oopar. Oopar daen: do sheeshe ki plates ke darmiyan hawa ka wedge, aik sire par h oonchai ke patle spacer se juda, oopar baari baari andhere aur surkh fringe nishan. Neeche: Newton's rings: hamwar sheeshe par rakha plano-convex lens, aur andhere markaz wale hum-markaz andhere aur roshan halqe.
blocks.caption: Patli tahein, hawa ka wedge aur Newton's rings (Figs 15.11 se 15.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har surat mein patli tah ki oopar aur neeche ki satah se do inikas interference karte hain. Tah ki motai rasta farq tay karti hai; jahan yeh taqreeban sifar ho, aik inikas par aadhe chakkar ka shift fringe ko andhera banata hai.

blocks.text: Newton's rings tab bante hain jab plano-convex lens hamwar sheeshe ki plate par rakha jaye, taake un ke darmiyan hawa ki patli tah ho, jo chhoone ke nuqte par sab se patli aur bahar ki taraf moti ho. Sodium lamp jaise aik rang ke source ki roshni is hawa ki tah ki oopar aur neeche dono satahon se mun'akis hoti hai. Mun'akis shuaein rasta farq aur phase shift ke mutabiq constructive (roshan halqe) ya destructive (andhere halqe) interference karti hain. Kyunke markaz se barabar faasle ke tamam nuqton par tah ki motai barabar hai, fringes daire hain. Newton's rings se aik rang ki roshni ki wavelength aur lenses ka radius of curvature maloom kiya ja sakta hai, aur bareek optics mein satah ki kharabiyan pakri jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Newton's rings ka markazi nuqta andhera kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Chhoone ke nuqte par hawa ki tah ki motai taqreeban sifar hai, is liye rasta farq nahi, lekin sheeshe ki plate se mun'akis lehar (hawa se sheeshe par) aadhe chakkar ka phase shift leti hai. Is liye dono mun'akis lehrein aadha chakkar out of phase ho kar khatam ho jati hain.

items: Newton's rings: plano-convex lens aur hamwar sheeshe ke darmiyan hawa ki tah.
Gol fringes kyunke barabar motai dairon par; andhera markaz.
Istemal: wavelength, radius of curvature, satah ki jaanch.
